title: 50 First Dates
tagline: Waffles for breakfast. A first date every morning.
about: A Hawaii vet falls for a woman with no short-term memory and has to win her over again every day.

    StartersHukilau Café waffle housesCrisp buttermilk waffles cut into squares and stackedHow to make it250g plain flour2 tsp baking powder2 eggs375ml buttermilk60g butter, melted, for the batter40g butter, for the iron and serving100ml maple syrupWhisk the flour, baking powder, eggs, buttermilk and melted butter into a batter.Cook in a hot waffle iron until golden, in batches.Cut into squares and stack into little houses, then drizzle with maple syrup.Hawaiian poke cupsCubed tuna in soy and sesame over sushi rice in small cupsHow to make it300g sashimi tuna2 tbsp soy sauce1 tsp sesame oil2 spring onions250g sushi rice, uncookedRinse and cook the sushi rice, then cool.Cube the tuna and toss with soy sauce, sesame oil and sliced spring onion.Spoon the rice into small cups and top with the tuna. Serve chilled.Marine park chilli lime grilled pineappleHenry's job at the marine park with Jocko the walrusHow to make itAs written, serves 4Pineapple spears grilled until caramelised and charred, finished with lime juice and a little chilli salt.Peel and core 1 ripe pineapple and cut into 12 long spears.Mix 2 tbsp brown sugar with the zest of 1 lime.Brush the spears with a little melted butter and sprinkle with the lime sugar.Grill on a hot barbecue or grill pan for 2 to 3 minutes a side until caramelised and charred.Squeeze over lime juice and sprinkle with a mix of 1 tsp salt and half a teaspoon chilli powder.Serve warm.MainsLoco mocoSeared beef patties with onion gravyHow to make it600g beef mincesalt and pepper, to taste300g jasmine rice, uncooked1 brown onion1 tbsp plain flour500ml beef stock4 eggs2 tbsp vegetable oilShape the mince into 4 patties and season.Cook the rice.Sear the patties in the oil until cooked through and set aside.Soften the sliced onion in the pan, stir in the flour and stock and simmer.Fry the eggs. Serve the patties on rice, topped with a fried egg and the gravy.Huli huli pineapple soy chickenThe Hawaiian sunshineHow to make itAs written, serves 4Chicken thighs marinated in pineapple juice, soy, ginger and brown sugar, grilled until sticky, with rice and slaw.Mix 125ml pineapple juice, 80ml soy, 60g brown sugar, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp grated ginger and 2 crushed garlic cloves.Marinate 1kg chicken thigh in half of it for 4 hours.Simmer the rest for 5 minutes until syrupy.Grill the chicken over medium-high heat for 5 to 6 minutes a side, basting with the glaze, until sticky and charred.Serve with 1.5 cups steamed rice and a slaw of cabbage, carrot and lime.SweetsCoconut haupiaFirm set coconut milk pudding cut into squaresHow to make it800ml coconut milk100g caster sugar6 tbsp cornflour50g shredded coconutToast the shredded coconut in a dry pan.Whisk the coconut milk, sugar and cornflour over low heat until very thick.Pour into a lined tray and chill for the setting time until firm.Cut into squares and scatter with the toasted coconut.DrinksSue's Hukilau pineapple ginger coolerFresh pineapple blended with ginger, lime and mint, strainedHow to make it600g fresh pineapple chunks1 tbsp ginger, grated1 lime6 mint leaves250ml cold water330ml soda water2 cups iceBlend the pineapple, ginger, lime juice, mint and water until smooth.Strain through a sieve into a jug, pressing on the pulp.Fill 4 glasses with ice, divide the juice between them, and top each with a splash of soda water and a pineapple wedge.Lava flow cocktailGood morning, Lucy.
